svg.title: Electrons scattering from a target and from a quark in a proton
svg.desc: Top: a beam of electrons strikes a macroscopic target. Most electrons pass through and continue to the right, but one scatters straight back to the left. Below, an enlarged view of a small region of the target: an electron strikes a quark inside a proton. The quark recoils forward and the electron bounces back. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Bouncing back gives the target extra momentum
Elastic head-on collision with a target five times as massive. The projectile reverses, so the target
carries more than the incoming momentum; the total is unchanged.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
